Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-canoe-seakayak/

Paddle a wooden sea kayak made from local timber and explore the rich nature of Lake Naguri on this eco-tour.

【Fee】
¥6,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, kayak rental, food, etc.)

【Capacity】
2 two-person kayaks

【Guide】
Staff from the Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】
Drink, towel, change of clothes (you may get wet), clothes that can get wet, and sun protection items such as a hat or sunglasses if needed.

【Note】
Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
location: 集合 名栗カヌー工房（国際興業バス「ノーラ名栗・さわらびの湯」下車徒歩20分、または「河又名栗湖入口」下車25分）
